notes.title: Find All 8: The road to the Maya - Released!
notes.content: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3637730/FIND_ALL_8_The_road_to_the_Maya"][/dynamiclink]The continuation of the "Find All 8: The road to the Maya" series is out! Explore colorful city streets, unique jungle views and ancient temples of a lost civilization. Look for different hidden items and paint black - white locations with colored paints. Interesting, attention-grabbing picture, 4 level, 600 themed items, 3 interesting puzzles and pleasant atmospheric music are waiting for you.[/p]

notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40571956/ca4954ff1186270b92bf3c930c068641ce4e4fb8.png[/img]
Dear friends, Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays! We thank you once again and wish you all the best!
We want to bring you the happy news that next year we plan to release about 4 projects, which are now in the process of active development. Among them is, of course, everyone's favorite Find All.  And also we take part in the Steam Next Fest with our new the game CatBox.
P.s Find all planned two parts! :3
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655740/CatBox/?utm_mc

notes.title: A small update to the help system.
notes.content:
The help system has been changed, now the circle will be narrowed over time. The first time after 20 seconds, the second time after 40 seconds and the third time after a minute.
Also improved the system of obtaining achievements, and checking for achievements at the start of the game.
